description: This file defines the IntClass which provides an implementation of the Excel INT function, casting floating point values to integers with handling for arrays and errors.

classes.name: IntClass
classes.description: Provides functionality for casting floating point numbers to integers, mimicking the Excel INT function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Casts a floating point number (or an array of numbers) to an integer, handling errors and special cases similar to Excel's INT function.
